title: Deception platform analysis result
description: What Claude returns for one capture run. The controller validates this and ignores anything off-schema or off-allowlist.

run_id.description: Name of the saved run folder, e.g. portscan_20261013_153952.

analyses.description: One entry per attacker IP seen misbehaving. Empty array if the traffic is benign.

attacker_ip.description: Real source IP taken from the pcap (honeypot logs only show the Docker gateway).

stage.description: Most advanced ATT&CK tactic reached in this run.

techniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK techniques, e.g. T1046 Network Service Discovery, T1110.001 Password Guessing, T1595.002 Vulnerability Scanning.

evidence.description: Concrete observations with numbers: packet counts, ports, timings, log lines. No guesses.

confidence.description: 0 to 1. Below 0.5 the controller does not act.

recommended_decoys.description: Decoy templates to spawn, matched to what the attacker is looking for. Names only; the controller owns images, ports and limits.

summary.description: 2-4 sentence session summary: timeline, techniques, evidence. Feeds the final report.
